---
title: "Stage 3 — Persistence curves"
output: html_document
params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "reuse"
  write_figures: true
---

```{r run, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage3_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("3_persistence_curves.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage3")
rmd_params <- configured$params
model_paths <- persistence_model_paths(
  quasi_extinction_abundance = rmd_params$quasi_extinction_abundance,
  persistence_horizon_years = rmd_params$persistence_horizon_years
)
config <- stage3_config(list(
                          mode = rmd_params$mode,
                          taxa = "both", # fit both branches for application reuse
                          write_figures = rmd_params$write_figures,
                          loess_span = rmd_params$loess_span
                        ),
                        paths = model_paths$project)
stage3_result <- run_stage3_model(config, model_paths)
```

## Inputs

```{r inputs, echo=FALSE}
print(knitr::kable(stage3_result$input_summary, row.names = FALSE))
cat("Model:", stage3_result$model, "\n")
cat("Simulation horizon:", stage3_result$persistence_horizon_years, "years\n")
cat("Quasi-extinction abundance:", stage3_result$quasi_extinction_abundance, "\n")
cat("Elapsed seconds:", sprintf("%.1f", stage3_result$elapsed_seconds), "\n")
```

## Figures

```{r figures, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(stage3_result$figures[file.exists(stage3_result$figures)])
```
